name: Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Cook bacon in a skillet until crispy. Drain and chop. Reserve 1 tbsp drippings.
Scramble eggs in the same skillet over medium-low heat until just set.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan or microwave for 30 seconds.
Layer eggs, bacon, cheese, salsa, avocado, and sour cream down the center of each tortilla.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Slice in half and serve.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free cheese and skip sour cream or use coconut-based sour cream.
substitutions.gluten_free: Use corn tortillas or gluten-free wraps.
substitutions.low_carb: Serve in a low-carb wrap or as a bowl over cauliflower rice.
substitutions.vegetarian: Replace bacon with black beans or sautéed peppers.
